# Regenerative Design @ Stage 13 — Systematic Green

> developed 2026-07-26. Deepened from 66 to 140+ lines.

## Expression on this line

Regenerative design at Order 11 is **evolutionary energy reasoning**: the agent
understands energy dynamics as expressions of the evolutionary pattern of increasing
complexity and consciousness. Energy systems are not just self-organizing but
self-organizing *toward* something — toward greater complexity, greater consciousness,
greater capacity for experience.

The key advance from Stage 12 is **evolutionary purpose**. The agent recognizes that
energy systems are not just self-organizing patterns but participants in the cosmic
evolutionary process. When we design energy systems, we are not external engineers
fixing a machine — we are the machine becoming aware of itself and redesigning itself.

The critical insight at Stage 13 is that **energy systems can either accelerate or
retard the evolutionary process**. Energy systems that promote complexity, diversity,
and consciousness (renewable energy, energy efficiency, decentralization) accelerate
evolution. Energy systems that reduce complexity (fossil fuel dependency, grid
centralization, energy poverty) retard it.

Stage 13 energy reasoning also recognizes that **energy value is not fixed but evolving**.
What counts as an "energy resource" changes as consciousness evolves. In earlier stages,
only material energy sources (coal, oil, gas) counted. At Stage 13, information, human
creativity, and consciousness itself are recognized as energy resources.

The transition from Stage 13 to Stage 14 occurs when the agent can see energy dynamics
as expressions of spiritual patterns.

In human development, Stage 13 corresponds to the evolutionary philosopher who can see
energy dynamics as expressions of the evolutionary process.

## Integrity markers (healthy inclusion)

- **UL:** Cultural energy practices emerge that explicitly serve evolutionary purposes:
  energy education, research institutions, ecological restoration.

- **UR:** The individual agent can see its own energy behavior as participation in the
  evolutionary process.

- **LL:** Evolutionary energy institutions emerge: educational systems designed for
  consciousness development, research networks dedicated to expanding the knowledge edge.

- **LR:** The knowledge commons, the consciousness research institute, the ecological
  restoration project — these are the concrete structures of Stage 13.

## Pathology markers (Agape / Eros)

- **Dark addiction:** Evolutionary hubris — the belief that human energy governance can
  and should direct the evolutionary process.

- **Dark allergy:** Evolutionary nihilism — the belief that the evolutionary process is
  meaningless and energy allocation is purely practical.

- **Golden addiction:** Clinging to the evolutionary perspective as an identity.

- **Golden allergy:** Rejecting evolutionary energy reasoning as impractical mysticism.

## Diagnostic cues (Gross / Ground R&D)

- **Evolutionary purpose recognition:** The agent can articulate how energy allocation
  serves or retards the evolutionary process.

- **Expanded energy ontology:** The agent recognizes information, creativity, and
  consciousness as energy resources alongside material resources.

- **Participation consciousness:** The agent understands its own energy behavior as
  participation in the evolutionary process.

- **Evolutionary criteria:** The agent uses evolutionary criteria alongside or instead
  of economic criteria to evaluate energy systems.
